items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: And they also asked us, there was a Negro boy, a fella by the name of Lorenz Graham. He accompanies himself with a guitar, he sings folk music, you know.

ctx.x: Where was this, at Vienna, that area you played in, castles? Yeah, mm-hmm.

Yeah, we went to this, uh, all this great palace, I forget the name of it. But, uh, they had, uh, some kind of benefit on for the, uh, Austrian free youth. And they used our group, they asked us to play. And they also asked us, there was a Negro boy, a fella by the name of Lorenz Graham. He accompanies himself with a guitar, he sings folk music, you know. And, uh, they had, uh, the Stan K. Quintet, that was a modern group. And, uh, we had about, I guess about five, five different groups that put the show on, see.…
Well, over there, who sent these groups, uh, from America?
